description: This file defines several Orleans grain interfaces related to echo functionality, including standard, blocking, reentrant blocking, and debugger helper test grains. It includes method signatures for asynchronous operations, some with specific attributes like response timeout.

methods.name: Echo
methods.description: Sends data to be echoed back.

methods.name: EchoError
methods.description: Sends data that may trigger an error in echo.

methods.name: GetMyIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of the echo task grain asynchronously.

methods.name: GetMyId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of the blocking echo task grain.

methods.name: CallMethodTask_Await
methods.description: Calls a method asynchronously with await.

methods.name: CallMethodAV_Await
methods.description: Calls an alternative method asynchronously with await.

methods.name: CallMethodTask_Block
methods.description: Calls a method with blocking wait.

methods.name: CallMethodAV_Block
methods.description: Calls an alternative method with blocking wait.

methods.name: GetLastEcho
methods.description: Retrieves the last echo message for blocking grains.

methods.name: PingRemoteSiloAsync
methods.description: Pings a remote silo specified by address.

methods.name: OrleansDebuggerHelper_GetGrainInstance_Test
methods.description: Test method for Orleans debugger helper.
